items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: And, uh, I was in the morning, up to the Patterson Hotel in South Ramsey, and Boyd and Julia. I was in the Eureka band now. ... And, uh, we went to meet him at the other main railroad station at night.

ctx.x: Club what was it? The Club what?

Forest. Club Forest. That's where Loi was playing. The Club was a fall band. This band wasn't my regular band. I don't know. I was still playing with my the party. I was in the Eureka band. Some of the bands had to die.
This must have been around about the time you were playing with Arnold De Pass. Yes.
